messages:
Sara (Partnerships): FYI — OmniCloud co-sell POC kicks off next Tue. They want formal security answers + final pricing before the demo. Can we triage blockers?
Alex (Solutions): I can drive the arch doc. Need SAML details and their expected RPS for the POC.
Mike (Eng-ML): I'll size the Dedicated pool and check quantization profile impact on latency. cc @Prashant for entitlements/security checklist.
Jess (Sales-EE): Sales asked for a capped pilot price and a fallback plan if latency > 200ms. They're sensitive to data residency too.
Prashant (Security): Send their completed security questionnaire. Also need their network topology and whether they require customer-managed keys (CMK).
Sara (Partnerships): Attached questionnaire is in their email. Pasting the top asks: 1) Data residency EU-only, 2) SOC2 + contractual audit rights, 3) SAML SSO + user provisioning via SCIM.
Alex (Solutions): Preference: can we run POC in EU region with Dedicated capacity? If yes, I'll draft a minimal topology.
Mike (Eng-ML): Yes, EU Dedicated is available. Rough estimate: 2x A100 equiv for 50 RPS chat or 4x for 100 RPS. For latency: with prefix caching we should hit ~120-180ms p50.
Jess (Sales-EE): Can you put those numbers in a short slide? Partner execs want a single-sheet number.
Alex (Solutions): Will do. Draft topology snippet below for ops review:
```
VPC (customer) <--> Private Link <--> Redwood Private (eu-west-1)
- Dedicated pool (2x-GPU)
- KMS integration (option: customer CMK)
- SAML + SCIM via partner IdP
```
Mike (Eng-ML): Also flagging a model fallback plan: include an open quantized variant (gptq) as fallback if load spikes. That reduces memory but might change token quality — we'll A/B test.
Prashant (Security): From security side: CMK supported, need KMS policy + key rotation SLA. For SOC2 + audit rights, legal to confirm but we can provide standard artifacts. Share the security questionnaire answers by EOD tomorrow.
Sara (Partnerships): Blocker: partner legal wants an explicit data deletion guarantee after pilot ends. Is that covered by our retention controls?
Prashant (Security): Yes — we can set retention to 0 and purge KV caches + logs on termination. Need a signed SOW clause.
Jess (Sales-EE): Pricing ask: partner wants a 30-day pilot price cap and a consumption floor. Finance touched base; can we offer an 80% discount up to X tokens then standard rates?
Alex (Solutions): We can propose: reserved capacity for the pilot at 50% list price with a token cap. Ops: confirm billing path for partner-managed pilots.
Mike (Eng-ML): Ops note: if they use CMK and Private network, spin-up lead time is ~48 hours.
deploy-bot: Deployment queue updated: reserved-pools request queued (ticket #POC-4498). Estimated spin-up ETA 46h.
Sara (Partnerships): Action items: 1) Alex — draft arch + one-pager (today), 2) Mike — perf + fallback doc (tomorrow), 3) Prashant — questionnaire answers + retention language (EOD), 4) Jess — confirm pricing ask with finance and loop legal.
Alex (Solutions): Acked. I'll post the one-pager in #partnerships-after-hrs for quick review.
Mike (Eng-ML): Will run a quick microbenchmark on the quantized variant and share logs.
Prashant (Security): I'll add KMS policy sample and the purge checklist.
Jess (Sales-EE): Thanks team — I'll prep partner-facing slide and schedule a sync with OmniCloud for Thurs. :thumbsup:
Sara (Partnerships): Great — keep updates here. If anything blocks spin-up ping @deploy-bot and tag me.
